newsitem.title: UK: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - May 19.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - May 19.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in two London-based Arabic-language newspapers on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Trade between Gulf Arab states and Japan rises to $37.5 billion in 1996 from $33.5 billion the previous year.
- Jordanian cement firm offers 33 percent of its shares to foreign investors.
- Palestinian bank operates 75 percent of its deposits abroad.
- Qatar signs an agreement with Phillips Petroleum Co to set up a $750 million petrochemical complex.
- Trade between Saudi Arabia and France worth 14 billion riyals in 1996.
- Around 2.6 million tourists visited Morocco in 1996.
